name: Generic Fish Species Classification
description: Names the family, genus and species of each detected fish. Knows 15100 species in 3733 genera and 579 families worldwide. Used together with a fish detection or segmentation model.

name: Sulawesi Fish Species Classification
description: Names the family, genus and species of each detected fish. Knows 1196 species in 359 genera and 82 families from the Sulawesi area. Used together with a fish detection or segmentation model.

name: Apoidea Species Classification
description: Names the family, genus and species of each detected bee or apoid wasp. Knows 5429 species in 468 genera and 11 families. Used together with an Apoidea detection or segmentation model.
